footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 27, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 4.3% to $15.5B in 2025 (ended Dec 27, 2025). Gross margin was 36.4%, versus 36.3% a year earlier, and operating income was flat at $1.5B, a 9.5% margin.
Net income fell 0.5% to $1.1B, or $2.06 per share. Operating cash flow was $1.6B and free cash flow $740M, versus $637M; Tractor Supply returned $849M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Tractor Supply Company Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
